texts.name: Nadine
texts.biography: Nadine was raised among the ash dunes west of Astral, where wind can uncover a city overnight. Her bond with dust and ash elementals makes her an invaluable guide through the shifting wastes.

specialty.description: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Dust Elementals or Ash Elementals for each level attained after 5th level.
specialty.name: Dust Elementals
